name: Hell Trap
source:
Yul wants revenge.

He will make the person he hates the most suffer the same way they made him suffer.

…And what hurts more than having your beloved family taken away?

But while Yul prepares to kill the daughter of the person he hates the most, things take unexpected turns and he finds himself with a strange but deep connection to exactly the girl that he planned to kill. 

[From [url=https://marikatti.itch.io/hell-trap]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尤尔想要报仇。

他会让他最讨厌的人受苦，就像他们让他受苦一样。

……还有什么比你心爱的家人被带走更让人痛苦的呢？

但是，当尤尔准备杀死他最讨厌的人的女儿时，事情发生了意想不到的转变，他发现自己与他计划杀死的女孩有着奇怪但深厚的联系。

[来自[url=https://marikatti.itch.io/hell-trap]itch.io[/url]]
